_comment: This is a STARTER sample database with a handful of very common medicines, so main.py has something real to look up against while you test. The generic uses described here (paracetamol for fever/pain, ORS for dehydration, etc.) are standard, well-known medical facts. The exact Nepal-market BRAND NAMES are a small placeholder list - you should expand/verify these yourself against what's actually common in your village, since that's local knowledge I don't have reliable data on.

by_barcode._comment: Maps a scanned barcode number to a medicine id below. Empty for now - you fill this in as you scan real medicine boxes and note their barcode + what medicine it actually is. Example: "8901234567890": "paracetamol_500mg"

paracetamol_500mg.use_ne: टाउको दुखाइ र ज्वरोको लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ
paracetamol_500mg.use_en: Used for fever and mild pain (headache, body ache)

ors.use_ne: पखाला वा शरीरमा पानीको कमी हुँदा प्रयोग गरिन्छ
ors.use_en: Used for dehydration, especially from diarrhea

omeprazole_20mg.use_ne: पेट दुखाइ र एसिडिटीको लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ
omeprazole_20mg.use_en: Used for acidity and stomach pain

cetirizine_10mg.use_ne: छारछुई, एलर्जी वा चिलाउनेको लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ
cetirizine_10mg.use_en: Used for allergies, itching, and runny nose

amoxicillin_500mg.use_ne: ब्याक्टेरियाजन्य संक्रमणको लागि प्रयोग गरिने एन्टिबायोटिक
